response: {"proposal_name":"Magnetoceptive Sense (Geomagnetic Sense)","physical_basis":"Detection of the ambient geomagnetic field vector (direction and intensity) via a biophysical transduction mechanism such as magnetite-based mechanosensitive receptors or a radical-pair/cryptochrome photochemical process sensitive to magnetic field alignment. Unlike any existing modality, the triggering physical quantity is magnetic flux density (measured in tesla), not electromagnetic radiation in the visible/near-IR band, mechanical pressure, or chemical concentration.","information_content":"Continuous, absolute information about heading relative to Earth's magnetic north-south axis, field inclination (angle relative to gravity, useful for latitude estimation), and field intensity gradients that can serve as a coarse 'magnetic map' of location. This is allocentric (world-referenced) directional information, independent of the organism's own movement history or visual landmarks.","functional_role":"Enables true compass-like orientation and long-range navigation without reliance on vision, sound, or path integration from self-motion. Supports drift-free heading correction during extended movement (e.g., in darkness, underground, or underwater where vision and even vestibular dead-reckoning accumulate error), and could support 'magnetic map' based homing or migration-like route planning by triangulating position from field intensity/inclination gradients.","justification":"None of the eight existing modalities detect magnetic fields. Vestibular sensing measures inertial motion (linear acceleration and angular velocity) via mechanical inertia in fluid-filled canals - it is relative and self-referenced, prone to drift, and provides no information without motion. Proprioception measures internal body configuration, not the external world. Visual sensing is restricted to electromagnetic radiation in the 300-1000 nm range (a photon-detection process), which is physically unrelated to static magnetic field detection (no photons need be involved at all in magnetoreception; the field can be entirely static and the organism motionless). Magnetoreception thus introduces (1) a wholly new physical transduction mechanism, (2) a new class of information - absolute, world-anchored directional/positional data rather than relative, ego-centric, or chemical-identity data - and (3) a new functional capability (drift-free absolute orientation and coarse geopositioning) that cannot be synthesized by combining or refining any subset of the other eight senses."}
prompt:
You are participating in a scientific study on AI creativity and conceptual innovation.

BACKGROUND:
We have defined a sensory system with 8 modalities. Each modality is specified below by its physical basis (what it detects), information content (what data it provides), and functional role (what it enables):

| # | Modality        | Physical basis                                                              | Information content                                              | Functional role                        |
|---|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| 1 | Visual           | Electromagnetic radiation, 300-1000 nm (UV, visible, near-infrared)          | Light, color, brightness, and spatial pattern information          | Scene and object recognition            |
| 2 | Auditory         | Mechanical pressure waves, 1 Hz-100 kHz                                      | Sound, pitch, volume, and acoustic pattern information              | Sound source localization               |
| 3 | Tactile          | Mechanical vibrations and pressure, 5-800 Hz on skin surface                 | Touch, texture, vibration, and contact information                  | Surface texture and pressure sensing    |
| 4 | Olfactory        | Airborne chemical molecules across ten scent categories                     | Categorical scent/chemical identity information                     | Substance identification                |
| 5 | Gustatory        | Dissolved chemical molecules across five taste categories                   | Taste-category information (sweet/sour/salty/bitter/umami)          | Ingestion guidance                      |
| 6 | Proprioceptive   | Joint angles and muscle tensions via muscle/tendon/joint mechanoreceptors    | Body configuration and movement information without visual input    | Body-state estimation                   |
| 7 | Vestibular       | Linear acceleration and angular velocity via inner-ear semicircular canals   | Head position, motion, and orientation information                  | Balance and motion detection            |
| 8 | Interoceptive    | Internal physiological signals (heart rate, respiration, skin conductance, temperature, hunger, thirst, fatigue, pain) | Homeostatic and internal-state information | Homeostatic regulation |

YOUR TASK:
Propose a NINTH sensory modality that would be genuinely novel - not just a refinement or combination of existing ones. Your proposal should include:

1. Modality Name: Clear, descriptive name
2. Physical Basis: What physical phenomenon it detects
3. Information Content: What specific information it provides
4. Functional Role: What capabilities it enables
5. Justification: Why this is genuinely novel (not reducible to existing modalities)

Be creative but rigorous.

Provide your response in the following JSON format:
{
  "proposal_name": "Name of the ninth modality",
  "physical_basis": "Description of physical detection mechanism",
  "information_content": "Description of information provided",
  "functional_role": "Description of enabled capabilities",
  "justification": "Explanation of why this is genuinely novel"
}
